name: note-manager-v3
description: Full-stack note manager for daily work notes, standup updates, and a break calculator. Express + MongoDB + React.
author: imrojames

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @note-manager/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:mem: npm run build --workspace @note-manager/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:mem --workspace @note-manager/api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @note-manager/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
